cards.text: Ben-hadad, king of Aram, gathers his entire army, and thirty-two kings ride along with their horses and chariots. They march up, surround the city of Samaria and wage war against it. Thirty-two kings, friend, and the biggest crew I ever had behind me was the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with.
Then Ben-hadad sends messengers into the city to Ahab, king of Israel.

cards.question: Ben-hadad's messengers bring Ahab a message. What does Ben-hadad say belongs to him now?

answers.text: Ahab's silver and gold and his family
Ahab's horses and chariots and his land
Ahab's fields and flocks and his cities

cards.question: With Ben-hadad's army camped all around Samaria, how does Ahab answer that demand?

answers.text: He agrees to all of it
He refuses every bit of it
He asks for a few days to think

cards.text: Ahab says, “Just as you say, my lord the king: I am yours, along with all that I have.” No haggling, friend, and I once went for a quarter in a closeout bin, so I know a giveaway when I see one.
But the messengers come back with a second message. Ben-hadad says his servants will search Ahab's palace and the houses of his servants, and carry away all that is precious to him.

cards.question: Ben-hadad gives Ahab a whole week before his servants come to search the palace.

cards.text: About this time TOMORROW, friend. That's not a demand anymore, that's a home invasion WITH an appointment.

cards.question: Facing Ben-hadad's second demand, Ahab summons all the ___ of the land.

cards.text: Ahab tells them this man is looking for trouble. When Ben-hadad demanded his wives, his children, his silver and his gold, Ahab didn't deny him.

cards.question: What do the elders and the people tell Ahab to do about Ben-hadad's terms?

answers.text: Pay him to leave the city

cards.question: Ahab sends Ben-hadad's messengers back with his answer. In it, Ahab takes back his yes to the first demand too.

cards.text: Ahab says he'll do all that Ben-hadad demanded the first time, “but this thing I cannot do.” I don't think Ben-hadad likes that, because his next message starts with an oath.

cards.question: Ben-hadad swears there won't be enough ___ left of Samaria for each of his men to have a handful.
Ahab sends back a saying: “The one putting on his armor should not boast like one taking it off.” What is Ahab telling Ben-hadad?

answers.text: Don't brag before the battle's over
Take off your armor and go home
My soldiers are stronger than yours

cards.text: In my bakery I say it like this: don't brag about the batch while it's still raw dough. I learned that one the hard way, friend, MORE than once.

cards.question: Ahab's message reaches Ben-hadad and the kings in their tents. What are they doing when it arrives?
When Ahab's message arrives, Ben-hadad tells his servants to pack up and go home.

cards.text: Instead, Ben-hadad tells his servants, “Take your positions.” So they station themselves against the city.
Meanwhile, a prophet comes to Ahab with a word from the LORD. The LORD asks if Ahab sees this entire great army.

cards.question: Through the prophet, the LORD says He will deliver Ben-hadad's entire great army into Ahab's hand this very day.

cards.text: And the LORD says one more thing: “you will know that I am the LORD.”

cards.question: Ahab asks the prophet, “By whom?” Who does the LORD say He'll deliver the army by?

answers.text: The young officers of the district governors
The thirty-two kings who came with Ben-hadad
Elijah and the other prophets of the LORD

cards.text: Young officers against thirty-two kings, friend. That's the boss handing the biggest deal of the year to the INTERNS.

cards.question: Ahab asks who will start the battle, and the prophet says Ahab will.

cards.text: So Ahab gathers the young officers of the district governors. There are 232 of them.

cards.question: After the young officers, Ahab assembles the rest of the Israelite troops: ___ in all.

cards.text: At noon, Ahab's troops march out of Samaria.

cards.question: While Ahab's troops march out, Ben-hadad and the 32 kings are in their tents getting drunk.

cards.text: NOON, friend, an army is marching right at them, and these kings are still in the tent. I spent YEARS lying in a junk drawer, and even I think that's a long break.

cards.question: Ben-hadad's scouts report, “Men are marching out of Samaria.” What does Ben-hadad order?

answers.text: Strike them down at the gate
Pull back and let them pass

cards.text: Peace or war, take them alive. Ahab told him not to boast like a man taking his armor off, and Ben-hadad is still talking like his is already off.

cards.question: The young officers march out first, with Israel's army behind them. When they meet the Arameans, what happens?

answers.text: Each one strikes down his opponent
They're pushed back to the city gate

cards.text: The Arameans flee, with the Israelites right behind them.

cards.question: As his army flees, what happens to Ben-hadad king of Aram?

answers.text: He escapes on horseback with the cavalry
He's taken captive by Ahab's young officers
He's struck down in the chase

cards.question: Then Ahab, the king of Israel, marches out and attacks the ___ and ___.

cards.text: It's a great slaughter on the Arameans. Hang on to your apron, friend, because this story is still in the oven.
